criteria.criterion: Provide concrete clean/minimal inline player design alternatives at realistic thread widths for owner selection.
criteria.evidence: factory/work-items/DIAL-005/design/player-directions.html contains three concrete alternatives; approved PRODUCT.md records A · Studio as the selected direction. The subsequent host feedback does not invalidate presentation of the alternatives.
criteria.method: Checked the existing A/B/C comparison and the recorded owner selection of Studio in the approved product specification.

criteria.criterion: Selected design preserves regular player takeover, remote Pause and clear honest playback/error states.
criteria.evidence: Run run-bdeca29eb9fb recorded 28 passing tests on candidate 6148c3720703f4d6e066d434b07a49641a4a9823, covering takeover, remote Pause, state transitions and error handling. Local static renders documented in evidence/polish-review.md show readable remote, buffering and error text. This does not claim fresh live audio observation.
criteria.method: Used the earlier independent Verify's behavioral test evidence for this exact candidate and inspected the candidate state markup. No new owner report alleges a playback-state regression.

criteria.criterion: Design covers fixed player, bounded country list, light/dark themes, narrow widths and accessible controls.
criteria.evidence: The owner reports that the actual host card has an unwanted green-tinted background instead of neutral black/white theme surfaces, and that the Play/Pause icon sits too far upward. Candidate CSS in both public/player.html and public/discovery.html sets dark --surface to green-gray #242b27 and uses a custom #toggle::before glyph inside a grid button. The owner-observed host defects defeat the selected neutral Studio treatment and polished primary control. Earlier local screenshots did not reveal or override the host feedback.
criteria.method: Compared the owner's actual ChatGPT host visual feedback with the candidate's theme and icon CSS, and considered the earlier local 320px/560px light/dark screenshots.

criteria.criterion: Approved design implementation passes meaningful resource/interaction regression checks and independent Review/Verify, including actual host visual QA.
criteria.evidence: Run run-bdeca29eb9fb recorded 28 passing tests and run run-eb32cd2d2028 accepted this exact candidate. Actual host visual QA now reports unwanted green-tinted background and upward-offset Play/Pause icon. The required host visual acceptance therefore fails despite passing automated regressions. No screenshot, live audio check, or remote Pause host observation was supplied with this feedback, and none is claimed here.
criteria.method: Combined prior regression and independent Review evidence with the owner's actual ChatGPT host visual QA report for the same candidate.
